id: title:dmarchuk:raise the default batch audience fetch budget above the 180s query cap

review.posthog_relevance: Configuration adjustment for CDP workflow audience fetching timeout, potentially preventing premature failures in the warehouse ingestion path.
review.reason: The change is a configuration update increasing a timeout value. This is a maintenance and reliability improvement rather than a new capability or systemic architecture change. The score is 1 because it is a localized, bounded change without implementation or test evidence.
review.uncertainty: The actual benefit depends on runtime behavior and backend compatibility, which are not demonstrated in this configuration-only diff. No tests or implementation changes are visible.

observations.limitations: This chunk is a configuration change. No implementation, tests, or runtime behavior changes are visible. No score assigned.

observations.behavior: Configuration value change: CDP_HOG_FLOW_BATCH_AUDIENCE_FETCH_TIMEOUT_MS increased from 30000 to 185000.
observations.posthog_connection: This configuration controls the timeout for audience fetching in the CDP workflow. Increasing it allows longer queries to complete before the client gives up, potentially preventing premature failures or unnecessary retries against a still-running backend query.
